newsitem.title: FINLAND: Bonds and dollar take Helsinki bourse higher.
newsitem.headline: Bonds and dollar take Helsinki bourse higher.

text.p: Firmer bonds and the dollar's gains following the weekend's EMU stability pact boosted shares in fair trade on Monday, brokers said.
The market was also buoyed by Wall Street's strong opening after last week's jitters, they said.
"The tone was good and I think we could see more gains on Tuesday," one broker said.

Partek closed 1.00 markka up after announcing extra 2.50 markka dividend proposal and trade was boosted by a 111 million markka after-hours deal when Norwegian Aker sold 1.5 million Partek shares to Unsa, partly owned by Sampo.
The dollar's strength and a faster forest industry output growth in October helped paper stocks reverse Friday's losses in fair trade, brokers said.
UPM-Kymmene advanced 1.30 markka to 94.00, and Enso R share closed up 1.20 markka at 37.00. Metsa-Serla B share rose 1.00 markka to 32.70.
Telecoms major and bourse engine Nokia closed moderate trade 0.50 markka hgiher at 254.50.
